_note: Ingredients for the generated town. Every run mixes these into businesses, people and places. Business 'kind' decides its web page, what it sells and whether it's a POI on the map.

traits.debt: owes money to the wrong people
traits.gambler: plays the state lottery every day and loses
traits.loyal: believes every word on State Television
traits.ambitious: wants a Party card more than anything

electronics.label: Electronics shop
flavor: Repairs while you wait (wait not guaranteed).
All radios pre-tuned to State Radio for your convenience.

hardware.label: Hardware store
flavor: Drills, files, vises. Questions are not answered.
Ladders sold to registered households only.

pharmacy.label: Pharmacy
flavor: Prescriptions filled in the order received. Order not guaranteed.

gun_store.label: Licensed gun shop
flavor: Licensed sportsmen only. Purchases reported for your safety.

police.label: Police station
flavor: Report suspicious neighbours at the front desk.

ministry.label: Ministry office
flavor: Citizen Records Kiosk in the lobby.

plant.label: Truck plant
flavor: Ninth quota record in a row.

rules: Internet cafes must record every customer's ID.
Unregistered encryption software is a criminal offense.
Electronics purchases over 50 VM must be registered with your citizen number.
Two-factor codes now expire after 30 seconds.
Gatherings of more than 5 people require a permit.
Radio receivers must be pre-tuned to State Radio.
Printers must carry the citizen serial mark.
Hardware stores must report drill and file purchases to the precinct.
Public computers now log keystrokes for citizen safety.
Posting on Nod requires a verified citizen number.
The Oster bridge checkpoint now checks phones.
news: Marshal Darvan inspects {business} and declares it 'adequate'.
Power cuts in {street} are 'scheduled maintenance', says Ministry.
{business} exceeds quota for the ninth time running.
Interior Ministry: {n} foreign-funded provocateurs detained in the eastern province.
Weather: rain. The Ministry of Agriculture thanks the rain.
Bread delivery to {business} delayed 'for quality reasons'.
State Television: photos circulating on Nod are fakes made abroad.
New checkpoint opens on {street}. 'Honest citizens pass in minutes.'
{person} wins the State Lottery. Prize: a framed portrait of the Marshal.
